rows.en:
(The practical test is about to start, huh.
I've gotta work hard to get a good score.)

This test is to see how well you lot
can handle your EX-Gear.
Are you ready, \p?
Recall the EX-Gear Controls (Basic Moves) class
rows.notes: Choice. Shared male/female. Same pattern as c23834.

rows.en:
(The practical test is about to start, huh.
I have to work hard to get a good score.)

All right, that's enough!
Looks like you've mastered the basics.
Don't let up on your efforts from here on.

(I'm really glad I got a good score.
I'll keep this up!)

All right, that's enough!
I've got a rough idea of your level now.
You can still aim higher, so keep training.
(Well, at least I passed the test.)

(Next time, I've gotta work harder
to get a better score.)

All right, that's enough!
Looks like I'll have to teach you
everything from square one.
(Dang, I can't believe I failed the test...)
First up, 100 laps around the field!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. gurando = school sports ground.

rows.en:
(That's way too harsh right after a test,
Hilda-sensei...)

Letting your guard down or getting careless
is what leads to failure. Stay focused.
rows.notes: x6; Yamashiro's advice (the player answers 'Yes, Yamashiro-sensei'). Occurrences also tag '-', Gary and PLAYER/none; worded to suit any speaker.

rows.en: Yes, Yamashiro-sensei.

Now we're starting the practical test.
Today we're holding it somewhere
different than usual.
(Somewhere different than usual?)
(Today's the practical test. I have to do my best.)

(Today's the last practical test of the school year.
I've gotta work hard to get good results.)

\p-kun!
You've got a test now, right?
I'm rooting for you to get a good score!

Well, go give it your best.
The great Sheryl is cheering you on,
so you'd better be grateful.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. 'kono Sheryl ga' (Sheryl herself, no less) rendered 'The great Sheryl'.

rows.en:
Yeah, I'll go do my best.
Thanks for cheering me on, Ranka, Sheryl.

Now we're starting the practical test.
It's the last practical test of the school year.

Show me everything you've learned so far
in this test!
(All right! Time to give it my all!)

(Today's the last practical test of the school year.
I have to work hard to get good results.)

\p-chan!
You've got a test now, right?
I'm rooting for you to get a good score!

Yeah, I'll go do my best. Thanks for
cheering me on, Ranka-chan, Sheryl-san.

(I've gotta get to a shelter too...
Wait, where did Michel and the others go?)
rows.notes: Emergency: evacuation during the attack of the unidentified creatures (see c23934).

rows.en:
Michel, Luca! Where do you think you're
going in an emergency like this!?

Whoa, sorry, \p.
I just got called in by my part-time job...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. baito-saki = where he works part-time (S.M.S., revealed below).

rows.en: Michel-senpai, we have to hurry!

I know.
Damn, there's no time to explain it all...

Can't be helped... Follow me!
\p!
Huh? Michel-senpai!?

I was planning to bring this one along soon
anyway. It's just happening a bit early, that's all.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Michel answers Luca; the person he means (the player) is unnamed in the Japanese, so 'this one' keeps it gender-neutral.

rows.en:
\p.
I'm taking you to where we work part-time.
Huh? At a time like this?

It's because it's a time like this
that I'm taking you.

Because it's a time like this?
Michel... What kind of part-time job is it...?
It's the private military provider "S.M.S."

(The private military provider "S.M.S."...
A military force whose main mission is
supporting the New U.N. Forces, right?)

(I never imagined Michel and the others
belonged to S.M.S., of all places...)

(The two of them went to intercept those
unidentified creatures... Oh, looks like
they're back.)
rows.notes: mikakunin seibutsu = unidentified creatures (the Vajra, not yet named).

rows.en:
So the one Michel brought here
turned out to be you, of all people...
Ozma-san!?

Captain Ozma here is the leader
of our Skull Squadron.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. 'Ozma taichou' (unit leader as a form of address) rendered 'Captain Ozma'; his rank is Major (he says 'from tomorrow it's Major Ozma' in sms_702). sukaru shoutai = Skull Squadron (glossary).

rows.en: (So Ozma-san was a pilot...)

More importantly, Michel...
why did you bring me to S.M.S.?

After seeing your skills in simulator training,
I'd been thinking of trying to recruit you
into S.M.S. at some point, but...

I never thought I'd end up bringing you here
in an emergency like this.

How about it, \p?
Would you consider enlisting in S.M.S.?
What!? Me, join S.M.S....!?

If Michel's recommending you,
your skills shouldn't be a problem...
But the biggest question is your resolve.
My... resolve?

Think it over carefully. What you want to do,
what you're fighting for, and what you're
willing to put on the line...

Yes...
I understand, Ozma-san.

(If I join S.M.S., I'll be fighting
to protect Frontier with my life
on the line...)

(I can't get in with a half-hearted attitude...
I've gotta make up my mind, with real "resolve"...!)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. kakugo in quotes kept as "resolve", echoing Ozma.

rows.en:
(I need to get to a shelter too...
Wait, where did Michel-kun and the others go?)

Michel-kun, Luca-kun! Where do you think
you're going in an emergency like this!?

Because it's a time like this?
Michel-kun... What kind of part-time job is it...?

(The private military provider "S.M.S."...
A military force whose main mission is
supporting the New U.N. Forces, right?)

(I never imagined Michel-kun and the others
belonged to S.M.S., of all places...)

(The two of them went to intercept those
unidentified creatures... Oh, looks like
they're back.)
(So Ozma-san was a pilot...)

More importantly, Michel-kun...
why did you bring me to S.M.S.?
What!? Me, join S.M.S....!?

Yes...
I understand... Ozma-san.

(If I join S.M.S., I'll be fighting
to protect Frontier with my life
on the line...)

uncertain: c23937: 'Ozma taichou' rendered 'Captain Ozma' (no glossary entry for taichou as a title; ranks list has Capt. for taii/kanchou). His actual rank is Major, stated in the next scene (sms_702, c23969). A reviewer may prefer 'the boss' or 'Commander'.
c23926: Michel's unnamed object (the player) rendered 'this one' to stay gender-neutral in a line shared by both versions.
c23904: occurrence list tags this x6 line with '-', Yamashiro, Gary and PLAYER/none; the scene shows it is Yamashiro's advice.
